basic_info.description: Fall in love on Chattanooga Street! This enchanting 1876 Italianate Victorian in Noe Valley blends historic charm with modern comfort. Just steps from 24th Street's lively corridor, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers a flexible layout perfect for today's lifestyle. The main level features high ceilings, 2-3 bright bedrooms, 1.5 baths, and a cozy sitting area with a fireplace. The front double parlor can serve as two bedrooms or a bedroom and office, while the spacious living room opens to a private deck. The sunlit kitchen flows to a terrace and lush backyard, ideal for entertaining. The lower level, with its own entrance, includes a one-bedroom suite for multi-generational living, home office, or rental income, complete with a remodeled bath, kitchen, and light-filled living room. With over 2,000 square feet, charming outdoor spaces, garage parking, and ample storage, this home balances whimsy and convenience. A rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco history with vibrant appealwelcome home!
